text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Aston Machan's Sprinters Stakes last year was amazing too, wasn't it?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, even though she was still in the Classic class,
she had the momentum to kick around the Senior girls!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: So this year, an even stronger Marchan will make her debut, huh. Can't wait~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As if the incident at the Takamatsunomiya Kinen had been nothing more than an illusion...
A multitude of spectators eagerly awaited her entry onto the track.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, as for Aston Machan—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
Do you want to see my secret weapon?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
You want to see? Yes, you do.
Understood.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ta-da. It's the official URA
Aston Machan mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The person in charge went out of their way to bring the finished product by just now.
They said it would be faster than mailing it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...What do you think?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it.
It's not something to be congratulated on.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I never expected to be turned down.
...I don't really get it,
but I'll try sharing my impressions anyway."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that's true.
However, that's not quite what I mean.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, could it be that you're
superimposing someone onto Machan?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: For example, whenever you draw a nice picture, Trainer-san also—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Spot on.
I'm so, so happy.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Honestly, I'm so happy I could melt.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: And so, here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Saying that, she handed over the mascot.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...It's her very first official mascot.
Is it really alright for her not to keep it herself?"
choice_data_list: Is it really okay for me to take this?
Is it really okay for me to take this?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Because I made a promise, you see.
That once the official mascot was made, I would give the very first one to you.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Mar-chan wants to buy it herself.
So, here you go.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I try picking up the mascot.
It felt just a little bit heavier than the Prototype 3.0
I received previously.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Listen closely, Trainer.
You must not get distracted solely by
the official URA mascot.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"Today's race is
veeeery special too!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Look closely, burn it into your memory,
and lock it deep within your heart.
choice_data_list: You're unusually fired up, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Since there was a request for it.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"You want to see Chan-me
shining brighter than anyone."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Since it can't be helped,
I'll show it to you. That is the story.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe.
Well then, I'm heading off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With her usual smile,
Aston Machan ran off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before long, Nakayama Racecourse erupted in cheers.
A second legend was about to begin.
